text:
[issue by Neposis]
Mod: Sophisticated Storage
Version: 1.4.50 (NeoForge 1.21.8)
Core: Sophisticated Core 1.3.65

Environment:
Minecraft 1.21.8
NeoForge 21.8.35
Dedicated server (Linux, Java 21)

Good afternoon, 
I am having an issue where my server insta crashes as soon as I right click the compression upgrade onto a limited barrel 3 (only tested black) or trying to insert it in via the interface. Maybe caused by a client side call on server?

java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: net/minecraft/client/renderer/texture/TextureAtlas
    at net.p3pp3rf1y.sophisticatedstorage.upgrades.compression.CompressionInventoryPart.<clinit>(CompressionInventoryPart.java:30)

Full crash log: 
[crash-2025-08-28_22.25.08-server.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22034344/crash-2025-08-28_22.25.08-server.txt)

Kind regards,
Nepo

[comment by P3pp3rF1y (owner)]
Thanks for reporting this. Looks like I introduced client side code where it doesn't belong during the port and because of that it crashed for you on dedicated server. Just released new versions of SophisticatedCore and SophisticatedStorage to fix this issue.
